# manifest.txt — the CALIBRATION AS CONTRACT.

# Every number here is asserted twice by scripts/check-roadmap-slug-matching.sh:
#   1. against the literal const declarations in internal/validator/validator.go
#   2. against the actual line counts of the fixture files next to this one
# Changing a constant in Go without regenerating this corpus fails the gate; changing this
# manifest without regenerating the verdicts fails it too. That two-way lock is the whole
# point: ML-3A measured the threshold instead of choosing it, and a measured value that
# nothing pins goes back to being a choice.
#
